name: QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen)
summary: A sealed fit with adjustable listening ANC.
features: Listening noise cancellation with adjustable modes.
Built-in microphones and Bluetooth phone calling.
IPX4 water resistance; either earbud can be used for calls.
consideration: Listening ANC reduces what you hear. Call-microphone processing affects what the other person hears. Neither is a Vocari test result.

name: FREE 2.0
summary: True wireless earbuds with rated attenuation.
features: Manufacturer-rated 25 dB NRR with foam tips.
22 dB NRR with supplied double-flange silicone tips.
Bluetooth calling, noise-isolating microphones and IP45 rating.
consideration: Choose FREE 2.0, not FREE 2.0 Listen Only, which has no microphone. Protection depends on correct fit and the specified tips.

name: LINK 2.0 — Headband
features: Headband model: manufacturer-rated 25 dB NRR.
Bluetooth calling with a built-in microphone.
Optional boom microphone sold separately; IPX4 rating.
consideration: The Helmet Mount variant has a different rating. Check the exact model and protective-equipment fit before buying.

name: PRO 2.0
summary: A neck-cable design for a working day.
features: Manufacturer-rated 27 dB NRR.
Noise-isolating call microphone and Bluetooth dual pairing.
Ear hooks, neck cable and IP67 rating.
consideration: The NRR is a US laboratory rating, not a guaranteed real-world reduction. Follow fitting instructions and workplace requirements.

name: Endurance Peak 4
summary: Ear hooks for an active day.
features: TwistLock ear hooks and an IP68 earbud rating.
Six microphones for calls; Bluetooth HFP documented.
Listening ANC is separate from microphone noise reduction.
consideration: A secure fit is useful for movement. This is not rated hearing protection.

name: Work Buds
summary: In-ear listening with a detachable boom.
features: Detachable boom microphone fits either earbud.
Bluetooth HFP and multipoint documented.
Call-microphone noise reduction and a USB-C charging dock.
consideration: The boom gives you another way to position the microphone near your voice. Test its fit and pickup on your own phone.

name: OpenComm2 2025 Upgrade
summary: A boom microphone for voice-focused work.
features: Adjustable boom microphone with DSP call-noise reduction.
Mobile-focused Bluetooth model; HFP documented.
Open-ear design, IP55 rating and USB-C charging.
consideration: This is the mobile headset version. The separate UC package is aimed at computer connections.

name: OpenRun Pro 2
summary: A wraparound option for walking and activity.
features: Open-ear design combining bone and air conduction.
Dual microphones with manufacturer-described AI call-noise reduction.
IP55 rating; standard and mini sizes.
consideration: Choose the right frame size. Open-ear listening is not hearing protection.

name: LinkBuds Open (WF-L910)
summary: An open-ring fit for everyday conversation.
features: Open-ring earbuds that leave the ear canal open.
Bluetooth HFP and HSP listed in Sony specifications.
IPX4 water resistance.
consideration: This model does not offer listening ANC or conventional in-ear noise isolation.

name: AeroFit 2
summary: An open-ear option with adjustable hooks.
features: Four-position adjustable ear hooks.
Four microphones with manufacturer-described AI call-noise reduction.
IP55 earbud rating; Bluetooth calling documented.
consideration: An open ear canal can help you hear your surroundings. It does not guarantee awareness in every setting.
